nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Financial assistance mechanism of the Government of India for poor patients suffering from major life-threatening diseases and requiring treatment in eligible government hospitals/institutions.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Poor patients meeting the income and disease/treatment conditions prescribed by the current RAN guidelines and treated at eligible institutions.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
